semiconductor_relevance: High — KISCO (Deutschland) GmbH specializes in advanced materials and chemicals specifically tailored for the semiconductor industry.
summary: KISCO (Deutschland) GmbH, the European branch of KISCO LTD. from Japan, provides unique materials and eco-friendly cleaning chemicals for the semiconductor market. Their offerings include surface finishing technologies for plating and etching processes, as well as specialized glass materials for lithography.
capabilities: Eco-friendly cleaning process chemicals for front-end processes
Surface finishing technology for plating and etching
Moldable UV transmitting glass for lithography

regional_presence.Europe: KISCO (Deutschland) GmbH serves as the European branch, focusing on the semiconductor market.
